findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get-checkout-link, create-checkout-session, get-order-status, get-esim-activation, check-esim-usage, list-topup-options · Public sink: get-checkout-link, create-checkout-session, get-order-status, get-esim-activation, check-esim-usage, list-topup-options.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get-checkout-link, create-checkout-session, get-order-status, get-esim-activation, check-esim-usage, list-topup-options · Public sink: get-checkout-link, create-checkout-session, get-order-status, get-esim-activation, check-esim-usage, list-topup-options

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
